schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.subject: The incident report or production incident being described.
schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.aliases: Alternative identifiers or names for the incident, affected service, or platform.
schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.incident_id: Unique incident identifier, such as INC-2001.
schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.severity: Declared incident severity level, such as SEV1, SEV2, or SEV3.
schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.incident_date: Calendar date on which the incident occurred.
schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.affected_service: Service, platform, or API affected by the incident.
schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.outage_scope: Extent of the outage, such as partial or complete.
schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.duration_minutes: Incident duration in minutes until full recovery.
schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.root_cause: Determined technical cause of the incident.
schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.report_author: Person who wrote the incident report.
schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.recovery_status: Whether the incident reached full recovery or remained unresolved in the report.
schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.mitigation_actions: Concrete remediation actions mentioned, such as traffic rerouting or deploying a fix.
schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.operational_dependencies: Named systems or dependencies involved in operating the affected service, such as the configuration service, paging system, or observability stack.
schema1|incident|e4f7565f2cd92cbcfec10d7.relevant_controls: Specific technical safeguards or operating constraints stated as relevant to the service, such as mutual TLS, readiness checks, circuit-breaker thresholds, or log-retention periods.

schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.subject: The runbook or service operational practices described by the document.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.aliases: Alternative names or identifiers used for the runbook, service, or operational scope.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.deployment_and_release: Deployment pipeline requirements, green-build gates, canary percentages and durations, feature-flag rollout, and image vulnerability scanning.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.configuration_and_schema: Configuration review and deployment practices, configuration-service usage, and expand-and-contract schema migration requirements.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.dependency_management: Dependency declaration, pinning, automated upgrades, deploy-time validation, and downstream dependency behavior.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.reliability_and_resilience: Graceful shutdown, checkpointing of long-running jobs, cached-response degradation, retries, circuit-breaker thresholds, and backup restoration verification.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.security_and_access: Mutual TLS, just-in-time audited production access, secret rotation intervals, and other service security controls.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.request_safety_and_limits: Idempotency-key requirements, correlation-ID propagation, gateway token-bucket rate limiting, and structured request metadata.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.observability_and_logging: Metrics export intervals, log retention and content, garbage-collection tracking, latency budgets, and central observability destinations.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.health_and_alerting: Readiness health-check intervals, alert routing, escalation policies, synthetic-probe frequency, and reliability indicators.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.testing_and_validation: Nightly staging load tests, production-topology simulation scale, synthetic critical-journey probes, and pre-promotion validation.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.data_retention_and_backup: Personal-information retention policy, central log retention duration, backup frequency, and weekly restore verification.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.capacity_and_performance: Connection-pool sizing model, quarterly capacity-planning cadence, per-hop latency budgets, and staging scale relative to production.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.operations_and_support: On-call handbook expectations, support-channel rotation duration, blameless post-incident reviews, and runbook review cadence.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.cost_and_finance: Monthly cost-report review responsibilities and coordination with the finance partner.
schema1|runbook|1520dcf9f1eee1c523de531e.traffic_and_service_protection: Encrypted service traffic, downstream failure handling, traffic allocation during canaries, and controls that prevent overload or thundering herds.

66d8146df8ed13e19d924f0bbebd1a9dfdabdfad.subject: Runbook operational practices for the service
66d8146df8ed13e19d924f0bbebd1a9dfdabdfad.deployment_and_release: Deploys use the standard pipeline and require a green build. Container images are scanned for vulnerabilities before promotion. Canary releases receive 5% of traffic for 30 minutes before promotion. Feature flags are rolled out gradually.
66d8146df8ed13e19d924f0bbebd1a9dfdabdfad.configuration_and_schema: Configuration changes are peer reviewed and applied through the deployment tool. Feature flags are managed through the configuration service. Expand-and-contract schema migration requirements are not stated.
66d8146df8ed13e19d924f0bbebd1a9dfdabdfad.dependency_management: Dependencies are declared in the service manifest and validated at deploy time. Downstream dependency behavior is not stated.
66d8146df8ed13e19d924f0bbebd1a9dfdabdfad.reliability_and_resilience: Graceful shutdown waits for in-flight requests to complete before exiting. Long-running jobs checkpoint progress so they can resume after a restart. Retries use exponential backoff with jitter. Cached-response degradation, circuit-breaker thresholds, and backup restoration verification are not stated.
66d8146df8ed13e19d924f0bbebd1a9dfdabdfad.security_and_access: Security controls beyond container image vulnerability scanning are not stated.
66d8146df8ed13e19d924f0bbebd1a9dfdabdfad.request_safety_and_limits: Idempotency keys are required on all mutating endpoints. Requests carry a correlation ID that is propagated to downstream calls. Rate limiting is enforced at the gateway with a token bucket per client.
66d8146df8ed13e19d924f0bbebd1a9dfdabdfad.observability_and_logging: Structured logs include the request path, status code, and duration. schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.subject: service reliability and operations runbook
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.latency_and_error_budget_monitoring: Dashboards track p50, p95, and p99 latency alongside error budgets, with latency budgets allocated per hop.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.error_budget_review_cadence: Error budgets are reviewed weekly in the reliability meeting.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.dependency_management: Dependencies are declared in the service manifest, validated at deploy time, pinned, and upgraded through automated pull requests.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.deployment_controls: Deploys use the standard pipeline and require a green build, while canaries receive 5% of traffic for 30 minutes before promotion.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.configuration_and_schema_change_controls: Configuration changes are peer reviewed and applied through the deployment tool, and schema changes use expand-and-contract migrations.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.staging_and_load_testing: Staging mirrors production topology at one-tenth scale, with nightly load tests run against it.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.request_safety_controls: Mutating endpoints require idempotency keys, requests propagate correlation IDs downstream, and gateway rate limiting uses a per-client token bucket.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.health_check_interval: Readiness endpoint health checks run every 10 seconds.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.observability_pipeline: Structured logs include request path, status code, and duration; logs are retained for 30 days, and metrics are exported every 15 seconds.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.synthetic_monitoring: Synthetic probes exercise critical user journeys every minute.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.resilience_mechanisms: Circuit breakers open after five consecutive downstream failures, retries use exponential backoff with jitter, cached responses provide graceful degradation, and graceful shutdown drains in-flight requests.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.capacity_and_resource_management: Connection pools follow the downstream capacity model, garbage-collection pauses indicate memory pressure, and capacity planning is revisited quarterly.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.backup_and_recovery: Backups run daily and are verified weekly by restoring them to a scratch cluster; long-running jobs checkpoint progress for restart recovery.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.security_and_access_controls: Traffic uses mutual TLS, production access is just-in-time and audited, container images are scanned before promotion, and secrets rotate every 90 days.
schema1|runbook|58474e7c5ce659f3444aaeb2.operational_ownership_and_reviews: The runbook is reviewed quarterly by the owning team, engineers rotate through support weekly, post-incident reviews are blameless and published, and cost reports are reviewed monthly with finance.

5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.subject: service reliability and operations runbook
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.latency_and_error_budget_monitoring: Dashboards track p50, p95, and p99 latency alongside error budgets, with latency budgets allocated per hop.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.error_budget_review_cadence: Error budgets are reviewed weekly in the reliability meeting.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.dependency_management: Dependencies are declared in the service manifest, validated at deploy time, pinned, and upgraded through automated pull requests.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.deployment_controls: Deploys use the standard pipeline and require a green build, while canaries receive 5% of traffic for 30 minutes before promotion.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.configuration_and_schema_change_controls: Configuration changes are peer reviewed and applied through the deployment tool; schema change controls are not stated.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.staging_and_load_testing: Staging mirrors production topology at 0.1 scale, with nightly load tests run against it.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.request_safety_controls: Mutating endpoints require idempotency keys, requests propagate correlation IDs downstream, and gateway rate limiting uses a per-client token bucket.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.health_check_interval: Readiness endpoint health checks run every 10 seconds.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.observability_pipeline: Structured logs include request path, status code, and duration; logs are retained for 30 days, and metrics are exported every 15 seconds.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.synthetic_monitoring: Synthetic probes exercise critical user journeys every minute.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.resilience_mechanisms: Circuit breakers open after 5 consecutive downstream failures, retries use exponential backoff with jitter, cached responses provide graceful degradation, and graceful shutdown drains in-flight requests.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.capacity_and_resource_management: Connection pools follow the downstream capacity model, garbage-collection pauses indicate memory pressure, and capacity planning is revisited quarterly.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.backup_and_recovery: Backups run daily and are verified weekly by restoring them to a scratch cluster; long-running jobs checkpoint progress for restart recovery.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.security_and_access_controls: Traffic uses mutual TLS, production access is just-in-time and audited; container image scanning and secret rotation are not stated.
5b213ba3df37c52667f6640e1fd1a7bfc7dd0dcc.operational_ownership_and_reviews: The runbook is reviewed quarterly by the owning team, engineers rotate through support weekly, and post-incident reviews are blameless and published; cost report reviews with finance are not stated.

1f057d1c3b7656b787ed2f2965c8c010706c672a.latency_and_error_budget_monitoring: The dashboard shows p50, p95 and p99 latency alongside error budgets, with latency budgets allocated per hop.
1f057d1c3b7656b787ed2f2965c8c010706c672a.dependency_management: Dependencies are declared in the service manifest, validated at deploy time, pinned, and upgraded through automated pull requests.
1f057d1c3b7656b787ed2f2965c8c010706c672a.deployment_controls: Deploys are performed through the standard pipeline and require a green build.
1f057d1c3b7656b787ed2f2965c8c010706c672a.configuration_and_schema_change_controls: Feature flags are managed through the configuration service and rolled out gradually, and schema changes use an expand-and-contract migration process.

1f057d1c3b7656b787ed2f2965c8c010706c672a.security_and_access_controls: Traffic uses mutual TLS, production access is just-in-time and audited, and container images are scanned for vulnerabilities before promotion.
1f057d1c3b7656b787ed2f2965c8c010706c672a.operational_ownership_and_reviews: The runbook is reviewed quarterly by the owning team, engineers rotate through the support channel one week at a time, post-incident reviews are blameless and published to the engineering wiki, and cost reports are reviewed monthly with the finance partner.

2c26196559983be7038bcec6e7bf248673a5a123.configuration_management: Configuration changes require peer review and are applied through the deployment tool.
2c26196559983be7038bcec6e7bf248673a5a123.backup_recovery: Backups run daily and are verified weekly by restoring them to a scratch cluster.
2c26196559983be7038bcec6e7bf248673a5a123.testing_environment: Nightly load tests run against staging, whose production topology is mirrored at one-tenth scale.

f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.observability: Metrics are exported every 15 seconds; structured logs include request path, status code, and duration; logs are retained for 30 days in the central log store; requests carry a correlation id propagated to downstream calls; dashboards show p50, p95, and p99 latency alongside error budgets.
f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.health_monitoring: Readiness checks run every 10 seconds, synthetic probes exercise critical user journeys every minute, and garbage-collection pauses indicate memory pressure.
f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.reliability_controls: The service uses graceful shutdown that waits for in-flight requests to complete, cached-response degradation, exponential-backoff retries with jitter, circuit breakers after five consecutive downstream failures, and checkpointing for resumable long-running jobs.
f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.traffic_protection: Gateway rate limiting uses a per-client token bucket, and idempotency keys are required for all mutating endpoints.
f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.capacity_management: Connection pools follow the downstream capacity model, latency budgets are allocated per hop and tracked on the service dashboard, and capacity planning is revisited quarterly.
f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.deployment_process: Deploys use the standard pipeline with a green-build requirement, while canary releases expose 5% of traffic for 30 minutes before promotion.
f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.release_safety: Feature flags are managed through the configuration service with gradual rollout, and schema changes use expand-and-contract migrations.
f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.dependency_management: Dependencies are declared in the service manifest, validated at deploy time, and pinned and upgraded through automated pull requests.
f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.security_controls: Container images are vulnerability-scanned before promotion, production access is just-in-time and audited, and service traffic uses mutual TLS.
f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.secret_management: Secrets are rotated automatically every 90 days.
f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.configuration_management: Configuration changes require peer review and are applied through the deployment tool.
f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.backup_recovery: Backups run daily and are verified weekly by restoring them to a scratch cluster.
f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.testing_environment: Nightly load tests run against staging, whose production topology is mirrored at one-tenth scale.
f9e259ff55d74402938d8f826660863ba3a74844.operations_governance: Engineers rotate through the support channel weekly; alerts follow the paging escalation policy; the on-call handbook documents escalation paths and expected response times; runbooks are reviewed quarterly by the owning team; post-incident reviews are blameless and published to the engineering wiki; error budgets are reviewed in the weekly reliability meeting; cost reports are reviewed monthly with the finance partner.
